outcome: The sticky ribbon now represents product identity and true global navigation
owner_impact: The sticky ribbon presents Virtual Lab with Eliseo Ferrante and Swarm robotics, and removes the current paper title, Experiment, Results, Showcase, Professor and simulator-status clutter. The scientific navigation is Simulation and Authoring; Help and Account remain global utilities. Simulator readiness is shown inside Simulation. Professor accounts retain Showcase and Capability requests through a temporary top-card action group so no existing function is stranded before the Control Panel redesign.

next.text: The #273 redesign continues with #418 — build the shared Experiment Control Panel. That ticket will reorganize the existing Experiment identity, library, revision/Working-copy, Save Revision, collection/organize and persistence actions into one coherent control surface. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: React desktop and mobile global navigation now expose Simulation and Authoring only; Help remains the existing onboarding utility and Account remains the existing account dialog.
Simulation navigation targets the explicit #simulation section and Authoring targets #authoring-workbench; both have sticky-header scroll margin.
The ribbon brand is Virtual Lab with Eliseo Ferrante and Swarm robotics; the current Experiment title is no longer rendered in global chrome.
The old ribbon simulator badge is removed; SimulationPresentation observes the existing worker status and renders an accessible Simulator ready/starting/problem badge in the Simulation header.
A bounded compatibility bridge in the existing top Experiment card exposes Showcase and Capability requests only when the Professor surface is available, proxying the existing authoritative actions.
Responsive production smoke asserts desktop and mobile global hierarchy and verifies that simulator readiness is contextual rather than global.
No simulation/runtime, Results, Authoring, revision, autosave, sharing, Showcase publication, capability-request, authorization, connector or workflow semantics changed.
